body: RULING ACCEPTED. PopulationAggregate joins the same candidate as the reference non-case smart-constructor shape. I expanded scope by one new test path only, align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/consumer/PopulationBoundarySuite.scala, reserved separately for the required external-package source probes. Production paths remain population.scala and matrix.scala; PopulationSuite remains the behavioral court. Planned boundary negatives cover companion construction/fromProduct, Product/productElement, unapply pattern extraction, and copy for both Aggregate and Receipt; positive controls prove of and derived receipt access remain usable. Explicit equals/hashCode and non-payload toString will preserve value semantics without generated case-class doors.
